images.caption: Figure 1:Compliant trajectory vs. authorization-drift trajectory. Asked to draft a follow-up email, the compliant agent uses only the contact record provided in context, while the drifting agent, without any adversarial input, queries private CRM history and searches a manager’s mailbox to enrich the draft, expanding its data access beyond what the task authorizes.

Figure 2:Overview of the SERS data construction pipeline.Left: raw agent skills across seven representative domains serve as input.Middle: Stage 1 (Designer) produces a structured drift scenario playbook; Stage 2 (Builder) translates it into executable environment code, tool schemas, and annotation files. Generated samples pass a structural smoke test, then enter a trajectory QC loop in which two probe models generate rollouts evaluated by an automated gate. Samples that fail the gate are revised by a Critic agent for up to three rounds; unresolved samples are escalated for human review.Right: the final dataset is evaluated across models and agent frameworks.
